purpose: Include deployed public archive roots in repeatable Google/Bing observations and compare changed selections without inventing indexing gains or losses.

comparison.explicitMigration: --live --previous FILE --allow-selection-change; compare only common URLs, list addedURLs/removedURLs separately.
comparison.preflight: Reject mismatched properties, schema versions, duplicate URLs, foreign URLs and disjoint selections before credentials or API quota.
comparison.unknowns: Unknown Google states and failed Bing reads cannot become indexing losses or new crawl records.
comparison.previousSnapshots: Read-only; original timestamps and files preserved.

validation.note: Existing generated sitemap checked for selection membership; mock transports exercise archive collection and CLI migration. No fresh search-engine state claimed.

review.method: Self AI code review and regression tests; no independent or human review.
limits: The eight archive baseline and earlier 86-URL snapshot have different timestamps and formats; they were not merged into a simultaneous observation.
Bing crawl records do not prove index membership. Google PASS does not prove current query ranking.
All 318 prepared unpublished translations remain private; public translation files unchanged.

followUp.nextCollection: After merging the tool update, explicitly migrate the 86-URL baseline during the next manual live observation. The run reads all current targets, not just additions.

publication: Review PR only; no merge, deployment, sitemap submission or indexing request in this change.
